# Security Policy

## Supported versions

Only the latest release of Thinking Methods receives security fixes.

Upgrade with `npm install @ysskrishna/ai-agent-skills@latest`.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please **do not** open a public issue for security problems.

Report it privately through GitHub instead: open the [Security tab](https://github.com/ysskrishna/ai-agent-skills/security/advisories/new) of this repository and choose **Report a vulnerability**. Include the affected version, steps to reproduce, and the impact you expect.

<!-- TODO(siva): adjust the response window below if you prefer a different one. -->
You will get an acknowledgement within 7 days. Once a fix is released the advisory is published with credit to the reporter (unless you ask to stay anonymous).
